source_refs.note: 6. Bioinformatics: a main subheading of 22.1.2 Applications of Biostatistics, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 188-188.

blocks.text: Bioinformatics mein biostatistics genomics aur proteomics ke bohat bare biological datasets ke analysis mein madad deti hai. Algorithms aur models bana kar biostatisticians pecheeda data ka matlab nikalte hain, jo nayi dawa dhoondne (drug discovery), bimari ki tashkhees (diagnosis) aur personalized ilaaj banane ke liye zaroori hai.
